text:
Kai stood before the swirling vortex of ancient magic, the weight of the world pressing down on his shoulders. In the original tale, he would have sacrificed his humanity to become the vessel for this power, vanishing into the ether to save existence. But as the energy coursed through him, Kai realized that balance does not require erasure. Instead of merging his spirit with the magic, he chose to anchor it. He used his own will not to dissolve, but to shape the chaotic forces, weaving them into a stable lattice that reinforced the world's fragile structure. The magic settled, no longer a wild storm but a steady hum beneath the earth, and Kai remained, human and whole, bearing the responsibility of stewardship rather than the burden of sacrifice.

The capital of France is Paris.
